0.original: Maru is plotting something tasty.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Deliver steaming victuals and amra to workers in the jungle.

48.original: You got time to spare? 'Cause I've got grub to share. Specifically with the folks protectin' the ruins an' temples in the Shroud of the Samgha...

49.original: Here, take these sweets an' eats an' follow the sound of rumblin' bellies. Tell them the Hippo Riders sent you...

50.original: What ho! Is something the matter?

51.original: For me? Why, my greatest thanks to you, good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>!

52.original: Of all the things to encounter in these jungles, a warm meal is a welcome surprise indeed.

53.original: We have resumed our regular patrols, so you may rest easy under the watchful eye of the Radiant Host. Be sure to pass along my regards to your Riders!

54.original: If it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! What brings you out this far?

55.original: Warm vittles with ripe amra for dessert! Why, my empty stomach was just serenading me with discontent but moments ago─might you have heard it?

56.original: If this aroma is to be believed, I daresay I shall soon become a true fanatic of the Hippo Riders' meal service. My thanks to you!

57.original: Oh, hello! Have you business with me?

58.original: Who would I be to deny such delectable generosity? I humbly accept!

59.original: We are by no means yet free of the shadow of misfortune, but it is precisely for this reason that I became a steward. After I have partaken in your kindness, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I shall finish the rest of my rounds with vigor!

62.original: Those temples an' ruins are important parts of our culture, so sendin' out the occasional warm meal to our guardians is the least we can do. Here's a little somethin' for you, too...
